caption: The drawing depicts a single architectural or ornamental object positioned horizontally in the center of the image. The object is rendered in shades of light brown and beige, suggesting a wood-like appearance. Its composition features a central, slightly raised and angular section with carved, pointed details. To each side, there are symmetrical, curved arch-like shapes extending outward and downward, ending in flat, squared-off edges. Hanging from the middle underside of the structure is a braided or twisted circular ring, also colored in the same light brown tones as the main object. The background is plain and uncolored, allowing the outlined and shaded form of the object to stand out clearly without additional context or scenery. In the lower left corner, there is faint, handwritten text.
title: Oxen Yoke
